# Yoosr - AI-Powered Customer Support Platform

## About
Yoosr is an AI-powered customer support platform that helps businesses build intelligent chatbots with a visual flow builder, knowledge base integration, and omnichannel support. Built for MENA region with full Arabic RTL support.

## Languages
- English (en) - Default
- Arabic (ar) - Full RTL support
- French (fr)

## Design Studio
- Bot Flow Builder: /[locale]/design-studio/[botId]

## Key Features

### Visual Bot Builder
- Drag-and-drop React Flow editor
- 19 block types including:
  - Start, Reply, Set Attribute
  - Condition (with expression evaluator)
  - Web Request (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE)
  - AI Task (LLM prompt execution)
  - HITL Handoff (bot-to-human escalation)
  - Ask Knowledge Base (RAG-powered Q&A)
  - Change Department, Apply Label, Set Priority
  - And more...

### Knowledge Base with RAG
- Embedding pipeline using NVIDIA embeddings
- Source types: Text, URL, File (PDF/DOCX)
- Vector search with 2048 dimensions
- Multi-turn conversation support
- Unanswered query tracking

### Omnichannel Support
- Website Widget (embeddable iframe)
- Telegram (inbound + outbound)
- Meta Messenger (inbound + outbound)
- Instagram (inbound + outbound)
- WhatsApp (inbound + outbound via Meta Cloud API)

### Real-Time Analytics
- CSAT scores and feedback
- SLA breach rate tracking
- AI token usage monitoring
- Conversation volume charts
- Tag distribution
- Unanswered queries table

### Multi-language Support
- Full trilingual UI (EN/AR/FR)
- Arabic RTL layout (sidebar flips to right)
- Locale-aware date formatting
- Widget locale auto-detection

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript
- Backend: Convex (serverless reactive database)
- Authentication: Clerk (multi-tenancy via Organizations)
- AI: OpenRouter API (multiple model support)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4, Shadcn UI
